definitions.short: Bedan , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H917. Bedan בְּדָן proper name, masculine (= עַבְדָּן ?). 1 a judge of Israel 1Sam 12:11 ; but rd probably בָּרָק , so ᵑ6 ᵐ5 We, compare Dr (see Judg 4:6 f.). 2 a Manassite 1Chr 7:17 . בדק ( penetrate, split ? compare Aramaic בְּדַק , explore ; but these perhaps denominative compare Lag GN 1882, 400 ).
